ai_summary: 3i Infotech Limited announced the designation of Ms. Shavee Sehajpal (CHRO) and Mr. Manish Falwaria (Business Head - BPS) as Senior Management Personnel, effective immediately. This move strengthens the company's leadership in critical human resources and Business Process Services divisions by formally recognizing two highly experienced professionals. The disclosure reflects routine corporate governance and organizational strengthening, with no immediate material financial impacts or red flags identified.
